items.title: The case for calling a tax professional today
items.summary: If you think your tax extension buys you a free pass, think again. Big Idea host Elizabeth Gore explains why the weeks before the extension deadline are actually one of the most important stretches for small business owners. From financing decisions and retirement contributions to digital sales and overlooked deductions, learn why working with a tax professional could save your business real money.
